name: Purge Miner Ore Sense live block and marker control

steps._note: Requires a disposable Rebirth Purge Miner whose Ore Sense is initially off. Prepare a real nearby Iron ore block within native pickaxe reach and a slightly farther Lead ore block inside the view range. No other ore closer than Lead. The crosshair targets Iron, and a native pickaxe hit can break that last Iron block. Guard stays on. Repeat in solo and on a dedicated client.

Inspect both screenshots for world-position geometry and color. Repeat while walking toward Lead, across a scan-center change and after world rejoin, checking the normal distance opacity and no stale markers. A profiler capture can count remaining SetPositions calls while stationary.
